name: XLA_MPA_DISTRIBUTIONS
description: This table keeps track the MPA accounting progress and the running recognized amounts for an event, transaction MPA distribution, MPA class and ledger combination.

columns.name: EVENT_ID
columns.description: Accounting event identifier.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Subledger application identifier for which the multiperiod accounting transaction is created.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger identifier. This can be a primary, secondary or ALC ledger.

columns.name: AE_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Subledger journal header identifier of the accrual entry.

columns.name: AE_LINE_NUM
columns.description: Subledger journal line number of the accrual entry.

columns.name: TEMP_LINE_NUM
columns.description: Intermediary line number for the subledger journal of the accrual entry.

columns.name: SOURCE_DISTRIBUTION_TYPE
columns.description: Classification of transaction source distribution.

columns.name: SOURCE_DISTRIBUTION_ID_CHAR_1
columns.description: Transaction source distribution identifier in character data type.

columns.name: SOURCE_DISTRIBUTION_ID_CHAR_2
columns.description: Transaction source distribution identifier in character data type.

columns.name: SOURCE_DISTRIBUTION_ID_CHAR_3
columns.description: Transaction source distribution identifier in character data type.

columns.name: SOURCE_DISTRIBUTION_ID_CHAR_4
columns.description: Transaction source distribution identifier in character data type.

columns.name: SOURCE_DISTRIBUTION_ID_CHAR_5
columns.description: Transaction source distribution identifier in character data type.

columns.name: SOURCE_DISTRIBUTION_ID_NUM_1
columns.description: Transaction source distribution identifier in numeric data type.

columns.name: SOURCE_DISTRIBUTION_ID_NUM_2
columns.description: Transaction source distribution identifier in numeric data type.

columns.name: SOURCE_DISTRIBUTION_ID_NUM_3
columns.description: Transaction source distribution identifier in numeric data type.

columns.name: SOURCE_DISTRIBUTION_ID_NUM_4
columns.description: Transaction source distribution identifier in numeric data type.

columns.name: SOURCE_DISTRIBUTION_ID_NUM_5
columns.description: Transaction source distribution identifier in numeric data type.

columns.name: MULTIPERIOD_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Multiperiod class for this distribution.

columns.name: LAST_GL_DATE
columns.description: Accounting date of the last multiperiod journal entry with Final status.

columns.name: NEXT_GL_EFF_PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: The denormalized period number of the accounting period for the next multiperiod journal entry of the distribution, ledger, and multiperiod accounting class. Defaults to the first open period of the ledger when the multiperiod accounting distribution row is first created.

columns.name: PROC_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Stores the processing status of the last accounting entry for the multiperiod distribution.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Multiperiod distribution recognition or reversal status.  Possible values are U (Final status journal has not been created yet),  P (Final status journal has been created but amount is not fully recognized yet), R(reversed), and F (entire amount has been fully recognized).

columns.name: FULLY_PROCESSED_FLAG
columns.description: It is used to determine whether additional multiperiod journals need to be created in the future. Once the distribution has been fully recognized or reversed, it is updated from N to Y.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Transaction currency of the distribution

columns.name: UNROUNDED_ENTERED_DR
columns.description: Total debit amount in transaction currency to be recognized.

columns.name: UNROUNDED_ENTERED_CR
columns.description: Total credit amount in transaction currency to be recognized.

columns.name: UNROUNDED_ACCOUNTED_DR
columns.description: Total debit amount in ledger currency to be recognized.

columns.name: UNROUNDED_ACCOUNTED_CR
columns.description: Total credit amount in ledger currency to be recognized.

columns.name: REC_ENTERED_DR
columns.description: Debit amount in entered currency already recognized for the distribution. This is updated when multiperiod journal entry is created in final status.

columns.name: REC_ENTERED_CR
columns.description: Credit amount in entered currency already recognized for the distribution. This is updated when multiperiod journal entry is created in final status.

columns.name: REC_ACCOUNTED_DR
columns.description: Debit amount in ledger currency already recognized for the distribution. This is updated when multiperiod journal entry is created in final status.

columns.name: REC_ACCOUNTED_CR
columns.description: Credit amount in ledger currency already recognized for the distribution. This is updated when multiperiod journal entry is created in final status.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PARTITION_GROUP_CODE
columns.description: Partition grouping information, when combined with the period, determines the database partition in which this multi-period accounting information will be stored.

columns.name: ACCRUAL_PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Accounting period of the accrual entry.
